description: Declarative mapping of every Unity Catalog table synced to Snowflake as an individual Iceberg table, grouped by layer (= the Unity Catalog schema name, which the sync_to_snowflake job tasks pass as the 'layer' widget — one task per layer, run right after that layer's pipeline; each layer lives in its own Unity Catalog catalog, passed as the 'catalog_name' widget). target_schema must already exist in Snowflake (Terraform: snowflake_schema.sync). The analytics/gold layer is deliberately absent: it is queried through a Snowflake catalog-linked database (create_snowflake_catalog_integration.ipynb), which discovers its tables itself. race_raw_quarantined is deliberately excluded — quarantined/rejected records aren't meant to be externally readable.
